notes.html: Pain it before the Mist lands, or hit it with damage. Why
Pain something else. Draconic Buster discards Garchomp's own. Why
Hit it with damage instead: a dog, Void Gale, or Haunter's Spooky Shot on a Poltchageist. It stops Fainting Spell's coin too. Why
Hit it with damage instead. Empoleon ex usually takes two. Why
It shields every Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon they have, not just itself. Knock it out with damage first, and Pain reaches the rest. Why
It shields their whole Bench, itself included while it sits there. Boss's Orders brings it up, where nothing protects it. Why
Expect Mist Energy on any Crustle that attacks. The non-ex Pokémon are the answer, and a Crustle has to go in one turn, since Jumbo Ice Cream heals the chip. Why
Pain them, or hit with Toxtricity, Haunter, or Chansey. Risky Ruins replaces it, and as an ACE SPEC it can't come back. Why
Risky Ruins replaces it, and Petrel finds the Ruins. Janine's is the Energy route that doesn't need Blissey. Why
Knock it out first. On their Bench it switches off the parked Mega's Shadowy Concealment. Why
While it is Active, your Pokémon ex have no Abilities: no Concealment, Fainting Spell, or Happy Switch. Surge still works, and the dog has no Ability to lose. Why
While it is Active, your Active Pokémon has no Abilities, so no Fainting Spell coin. Why
Knock it out first. Moved and placed counters skip Concealment and Fainting Spell. Why
It discards Special Energy. Neo Upper pays for the turn it lands; after that expect it gone, and keep a Basic Energy route behind it. Why
Item lock: no Rare Candy, Switch, Poffin, or Poke Pad. AZ's, Grimsley's, Janine's, and Surge all still work. Why
